translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
bari kharabi hai uss shaks ki jo peeth peechay doosron per aeb laganey wala , ( aur ) mun per taaney denay ka aadi ho ,
jiss ney maal ikattha kiya ho , aur ussay ginta rehta ho ,
woh samajhta hai kay uss-ka maal ussay hamesha zinda rakhay ga .
hergiz nahi ! uss ko to aesi jagah mein phenka jaye ga jo choora choora kernay wali hai ,
aur tumhen kiya maloom woh choora choora kernay wali cheez kiya hai-?
jo dilon tak jaa charrhay gi !
yaqeen jano woh unn per band kerdi jaye gi ,
jabkay woh ( aag kay ) lambay chorray sutonon mein ( ghiray huye ) hon gay .
